replies.body: Good news: it's already most of the way to a phone app. The site can be added to the home screen today, opens full screen with its own icon, and can send price alerts. Three paths: 1) Home-screen app (what we have): free, no app store, every update is instant. Downside: people have to know to tap 'Add to Home Screen', and there's no store listing. 2) App-store wrapper: the same app put inside a thin shell (Capacitor) so it's in the Apple and Google stores. About 1-2 weeks of work, a $99/year Apple account and a $25 Google fee, and Apple's review. Apple often turns down apps that are just a website, so it needs a few phone-only extras (better alerts, Face ID, widgets). It also needs a closer look at the money rules, since this app touches trading. 3) Full native app (React Native or Swift): best feel, but basically a rebuild, months of work, and two codebases to keep up. My suggestion: stay on 1 while it's invite-only and polish the 'Add to Home Screen' prompt, then do 2 when you open it up. Nobody has started anything. Tell the build chat which one you want.
